tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently attended a university-sponsored career workshop and found the information on job hunting very helpful. However, there were some issues with the workshop organization. You want to follow up with the organizer, Ms. Williams, to express your appreciation for the event and provide feedback on the workshop organization. Write an email to Ms. Williams.
bullets: Explain what you found especially helpful about the workshop.
Describe the problems you found with the workshop organization.
Suggest ways to avoid these issues in future events.
tasks.subject: Career Workshop
